g.text: Gas control mechanisms transfer, retain, biodegrade, or oxidize the pollutant

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Concept sketches, not equipment sizing. Scrubbing transfers pollutant to liquid; adsorption creates spent media; biological conversion depends on suitable
contaminant/loading; oxidation produces reaction products and requires appropriate operating conditions. Energy, secondary pollutants, fire/explosion
risks, and residual management are separate design considerations.
